findings.title: CVE-2026-92392 in proxy curl 8.22.0-r0

normalized_input.claimed_source: HTTP/2 server controls RST_STREAM during an upload
normalized_input.claimed_sink: curl upload retry handling frees Curl_easy while still referenced
normalized_input.claimed_control: Affected curl versions lack corrected stream/retry lifetime handling
preconditions: HTTP/2 upload; peer sends HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED or REFUSED_STREAM
normalized_input.impact: Use after free; potential remote code execution under additional upstream conditions

affected_locations.label: runtime package origin
affected_locations.detail: Pinned Caddy Alpine base carries curl/libcurl. Existing package override only updates brotli.

affected_locations.label: proxy implementation
affected_locations.detail: CGO_ENABLED=0 Caddy built in Go; no libcurl linkage expected.

affected_locations.label: shipped route
affected_locations.detail: TLS internal; reverse_proxy to fixed api:8000. Healthcheck uses wget, not curl.

reachable_path: Affected curl/libcurl package is present in the recorded immutable image.
Repository runtime entrypoint and healthcheck do not invoke curl uploads.
No supported attacker-controlled HTTP/2 upload path through this copy is established.

boundary_assessment.policy_basis: No SECURITY.md resolved for deploy. Dockerfile.proxy, Caddyfile and compose.local.yaml establish shipped paths; not a generic arbitrary-upload client.

exploitability_stack_rank.rationale: Affected binary package is present; product upload consumer and attacker control remain unproven. curl CLI ranked before library-only consumer.

evidence: Trivy snapshot 27 October retains two distinct Alpine package records, fixed version 8.23.0-r0.
Official curl advisory describes upload/HTTP2 reset conditions.
counterevidence: Static Go Caddy uses its own HTTP stack.
Shipped healthcheck uses wget GET/spider to a fixed localhost readiness endpoint.
CI curl executes on the host runner, outside the proxy image.
proof_gaps: No positive evidence connects a supported untrusted input to curl/libcurl upload within this image.
A package-version patch can be verified independently; it does not establish original exploitability.
findings.recommended_next_step: Apply available minimal Alpine package update as dependency maintenance, compare package manifests, rebuild and verify proxy HTTPS/HTTP2, health and exact advisory absence.
